title: Platform — GitOps & Secrets
description: Argo CD applications (sync, health, failed syncs, reconciliation, Git), External Secrets (ExternalSecrets, stores, webhook) and cert-manager (certificates, renewals, issuers), with the components' resources and error logs.

list.name: Argo CD syncs
list.textFormat: Applied a Git change or reverted drift

list.name: Failed syncs
list.textFormat: The sync did not complete; see the Applications table

list.name: Node restarts
list.expr: (max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) > max_over_time((max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))[30m:1m] offset 1m)) * on (node) group_left (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) (kube_node_labels)
list.textFormat: Pool {{label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool}} ({{label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning}}): spot preemption, upgrade or repair; its pods were rescheduled

list.name: Container restarts
list.expr: (changes(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"argocd|external-secrets|cert-manager"}[1m]) > 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"argocd|external-secrets|cert-manager"})

panels.title: Applications out of sync
panels.description: Applications whose live state differs from Git (OutOfSync) or cannot be compared with it (Unknown). With automated sync and self-heal this is back to 0 within seconds.

panels.title: Applications not healthy
panels.description: Progressing during a rollout; Degraded, Missing or Unknown otherwise (the Health column says which).

panels.title: Failed syncs
panels.description: Sync operations that ended Failed or Error in the time range, after their retries.

panels.title: ExternalSecrets not synced
panels.description: ExternalSecrets whose last refresh failed; their Secrets keep the previous data.

panels.title: Certificates not ready
panels.description: Certificates cert-manager could not issue or renew.

panels.title: Next certificate expiry
panels.description: Time until the first certificate expires. cert-manager renews ahead of expiry (renewBefore), so a low value means renewals fail.

panels.title: Applications
panels.description: Every Argo CD Application with its project, destination namespace, sync and health status, whether it syncs automatically, and its sync operations in the time range. Click an application to list its errors in the Errors in the logs row.

value.title: Show this application's errors in the logs below

targets.expr: max by (name, project, dest_namespace, sync_status, health_status, autosync_enabled) (argocd_app_info)

panels.title: Health over time
panels.description: Health of each application: when it was Progressing (rollouts), Degraded or Missing.

panels.title: Sync status over time
panels.description: When each application differed from Git (OutOfSync, until the automated sync applied it) or could not be compared (Unknown: manifest generation or the cluster cache failed).

targets.expr: max by (name) (argocd_app_info{sync_status=~"Synced"} * 0 or argocd_app_info{sync_status=~"OutOfSync"} * 1 or argocd_app_info{sync_status=~"Unknown"} * 2)

panels.title: Syncs
panels.description: Sync operations per 5 minutes by result. Every merge to Git and every self-heal of drift is a sync; Failed and Error count once per operation, after its retries.

panels.title: Reconciliation
panels.description: How long the controller takes to compare an application with the cluster (left) and how often it does (right). Slow reconciliations delay syncs and self-heal.

panels.title: Kubernetes API requests
panels.description: Requests of the application controller to the Kubernetes API by response code. 4xx: a resource is rejected (validation, admission webhook, RBAC); 5xx: the API server fails.

panels.title: Argo CD — Git, repo-server and API
Git requests
panels.description: Requests of the repo-server to the Git repository: ls-remote resolves the branch on every refresh, fetch downloads new commits. Failures: network, credentials, or the repository is gone.

panels.title: Git request duration (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of the Git request duration by type.

panels.title: Pending work
panels.description: Work queued in the repo-server (manifest generation waiting for a repository) and in the controller (kubectl apply or auth running). A queue that stays up means Argo CD is short of CPU or blocked.

targets.legendFormat: manifest requests waiting for a repository lock

panels.title: API requests by gRPC code
panels.description: Requests to the Argo CD API server (UI, CLI) by result, health checks excluded.

panels.title: ExternalSecrets
panels.description: Every ExternalSecret with its Ready condition (the last refresh succeeded), its reconciles and errors in the time range. A few errors right after a restart are normal (the webhook and the generators start in parallel); Not ready means the Secret no longer follows its source.

panels.title: Reconciles and errors
panels.description: ExternalSecret reconciles per 5 minutes (refresh interval, changes, retries) and the ExternalSecrets that failed.

panels.title: Secret stores
panels.description: SecretStores and ClusterSecretStores (provider connections, e.g. GCP Secret Manager). Empty while every ExternalSecret uses a generator.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (namespace, name) (secretstore_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="True"}), "kind", "SecretStore", "", "") or label_replace(max by (name) (clustersecretstore_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="True"}), "kind", "ClusterSecretStore", "", "")

panels.title: Controller reconciles
panels.description: Reconciles of the External Secrets controller (all kinds) by result; requeue_after is the scheduled refresh.

panels.title: Webhook requests
panels.description: Validation of ExternalSecrets and SecretStores on create and update. Errors here make Argo CD syncs of these objects fail.

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Every cert-manager Certificate with its issuer, whether it is ready, when cert-manager renews it (renewBefore ahead of expiry) and when it expires. A renewal time in the past means the renewal fails (CertManagerCertificateRenewalOverdue).

panels.title: Issuers
panels.description: Issuers and ClusterIssuers; a certificate can only be issued or renewed by a ready issuer.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (namespace, name) (certmanager_issuer_ready_status{condition="True"}), "kind", "Issuer", "", "") or label_replace(max by (name) (certmanager_clusterissuer_ready_status{condition="True"}), "kind", "ClusterIssuer", "", "")

panels.title: Controller syncs
panels.description: Syncs of the cert-manager controllers per 5 minutes (certificates, requests, issuers) and their errors.

panels.title: Webhook requests
panels.description: Validation and defaulting of cert-manager objects on create and update. Errors here make Argo CD syncs of Certificates and Issuers fail.

panels.title: Scrape targets up
panels.description: Every metrics endpoint of Argo CD, External Secrets and cert-manager; Down means the component is restarting or not reachable.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU of every pod in argocd, external-secrets and cert-manager.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set memory of every pod (what counts against the memory limit).

panels.title: Error lines by container
panels.description: Error lines of the Argo CD, External Secrets and cert-manager containers.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace=~"argocd|external-secrets|cert-manager"} (level:in(error, fatal, panic) or _msg:~"level=(error|fatal)" or _msg:~"^[EF][0-9]{4} ") _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | stats by (kubernetes.container_name) count() lines

panels.title: Error lines
panels.description: Error lines as <namespace>/<container>: <message>, newest first. Argo CD names the application (application=<name>); narrow with Message contains.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace=~"argocd|external-secrets|cert-manager"} (level:in(error, fatal, panic) or _msg:~"level=(error|fatal)" or _msg:~"^[EF][0-9]{4} ") _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | format "<kubernetes.pod_namespace>/<kubernetes.container_name>: <_msg>" as _msg
